subject: Attestation pack review and artifact logistics
messages:
From: Lisa Cheng <lisa.cheng@novanet.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@novanet.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Attestation pack review and artifact logistics

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As part of our RFP closeout checklist the security team needs a concise attestation pack we can attach to our procurement file. At minimum we need:
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest rolling 12 months) or a summary if the full report is NDA-protected
- ISO 27001 certificate and scope statement
- Completed SIG questionnaire (or a SIG crosswalk if you already maintain one)

Our target is to complete vendor risk review by next Wednesday (2027-12-08). Can you confirm what you can share publicly vs. what requires an NDA? Also, we have a short procurement questionnaire (see attached template) that asks for the control owner contact and evidence locations for a subset of 20 controls — that would be ideal to return in a spreadsheet.

If you prefer, loop in your security lead and we can set a 30-minute call to accelerate.

Best,
Lisa Cheng
Senior Procurement Manager
NovaNet Systems

Attachments: nova_rfp_questionnaire.docx (application/msword)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Cheng <lisa.cheng@novanet.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2027 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Attestation pack review and artifact logistics

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear checklist. We can provide a SOC 2 Type II summary PDF for public distribution and host the full report under NDA. ISO 27001 certificate and scope statement are shareable. We also maintain a SIG crosswalk that maps our controls to the SIG taxonomy; we can extract the 20 requested controls into your spreadsheet.

Proposed next steps:
1) I will circulate the public artifacts immediately (SOC2 summary + ISO scope)
2) Marissa (security) will fill the control-owner and evidence pointers for the 20 controls in the spreadsheet you attached
3) If NovaNet requires the full SOC2 report we can execute a one-way NDA — I can send a standard mutual/NDA template for quick review

Would a 30-minute sync on Monday morning (2027-12-06 09:30 PT) work to confirm scope and handoffs? Sean will own logistics and follow-up on procurement-side questions.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

[signature]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Cheng <lisa.cheng@novanet.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 04 Dec 2027 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Attestation pack review and artifact logistics

Hi Lisa,

I pulled together the initial artifacts and a short control mapping for the 20 controls you flagged. Attachments below — happy to walk through any control mappings on Monday. High-level notes:

- SOC2: We are providing a public summary (redacted) and can provide the full report under a standard NDA. The redwood_soc2_type2_summary.pdf includes the opinion, control categories in scope (CC1–CC7 mapping), and the period covered.
- ISO: ISO 27001 certificate plus a one-page scope.txt indicating production systems included.
- SIG: sig_crosswalk.csv maps the requested SIG question IDs to our internal control IDs, owner names, and artifact pointers (Drive URLs).

Attachments: redwood_soc2_type2_summary.pdf (application/pdf); iso27001_scope.txt (text/plain); sig_crosswalk.csv (text/csv)

A couple of clarifications to help your team triage quickly:
1) Several SIG items reference encryption-in-transit for internal service meshes. We list TLS v1.2+ for edge ingress and mTLS for cluster internal traffic; sample telemetry and policy docs are referenced in the crosswalk.
2) For key management, we provide a KMS proof-of-concept artifact; full HSM attestation is available under controlled disclosure.
3) Retention and logging samples are sampled extracts — if NovaNet needs full log retention configs we can provide an anonymized export.

If the procurement team can confirm which items (if any) require the full SOC2 report vs. the summary, we'll prepare the NDA in parallel. I can join the Monday sync to answer technical questions.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Security & Assurance — Redwood Inference

[signature]

From: Lisa Cheng <lisa.cheng@novanet.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@novanet.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2027 14:50:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Attestation pack review and artifact logistics

Hi all — this looks great, thank you for the fast turnaround. The summary artifacts and the SIG crosswalk should be sufficient for our initial assessment. A few follow-ups:

- We do need the SOC2 report for our legal file, but an NDA is acceptable. Can you send your standard NDA and a proposed DocuSign link?
- Please include the Drive folder link in the SIG crosswalk for the final submission so our team can pull the sample artifacts (the Drive link in the CSV was a placeholder).
- For procurement, we asked for the control owner email and a simple statement of evidence location (e.g., \"S3://redwood-prod-logs/audits/2027/\") for the 20 controls. If you can populate that into our attached spreadsheet and return by EOD Wednesday (2027-12-08) we can close vendor acceptance.

I opened a quick HubSpot ticket for the engagement: https://hubspot.com/contacts/records/DN-7841 — feel free to attach the final artifacts there.

If it's helpful, we can start the NDA in parallel; please send whatever you use and we'll get the DocuSign back quickly.

Thanks,
Lisa
Senior Procurement Manager
NovaNet Systems

Attachments: nova_rfp_questionnaire_completed_template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
